mapper.select: SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, A.BROD_NAME AS brodName, A.BROD_TOTALTIME AS brodTotalTime, A.BROD_USEYN AS brodUseYn, A.BROD_INTERVAL AS brodInterval, B.CODE_NM AS codeNm, B.CODE_DC AS CodeDc, BASIC_FILE_ID AS basicFileId, A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AS frstRegistPnttm, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS frstRegisterId, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM AS lastUpdtPnttm, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID AS lastUpdusrId, A.SEC_GUBUN AS secGubun, A.BROD_STARTDAY AS brodStartDay, A.BROD_ENDDAY AS brodEndDay, A.CENTER_ID AS centerId, A.BASIC_BROD_CODE AS basicBrodCode, ( SELECT E.CENTER_NM FROM TB_CENTERINFO E WHERE A.CENTER_ID = E.CENTER_ID ) AS centerNm, ( SELECT BASIC_GROUP_NM FROM TB_BRODBASICGROUP C WHERE A.BASIC_FILE_ID = C.BASIC_CODE ) AS basicGroupNm FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE B ON A.BROD_INTERVAL = B.CODE WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
SELECT CAST(CAST(B.CODE_DC AS INTEGER) - 10 AS VARCHAR) AS codeDc FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE B ON A.BROD_INTERVAL = B.CODE WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}

SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(CAST(CAST(B.CODE_DC AS INTEGER) - 10 AS VARCHAR)) = 2 THEN CONCAT('0', CAST(CAST(B.CODE_DC AS INTEGER) - 10 AS VARCHAR)) ELSE TO_CHAR(CAST(B.CODE_DC AS INTEGER) - 10, 'FM999999') END AS codeDc FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE B ON A.BROD_INTERVAL = B.CODE WHERE A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, A.BROD_NAME AS brodName FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A WHERE BROD_CODE != #{brodCode}
SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, A.BROD_NAME AS brodName FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A WHERE BROD_USEYN = 'Y'
SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, A.BROD_NAME AS brodName FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A WHERE BROD_USEYN = 'Y' AND SEC_GUBUN = 'SECGUBUN02'
SELECT A.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, A.BROD_NAME AS brodName, A.CENTER_ID AS centerId FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A WHERE BROD_USEYN = 'Y' AND ( A.BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} OR A.BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )

SELECT COALESCE(X.CENTER_NM, '연결지점없음') AS centerNm FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN CENTER_ID IS NULL THEN '연결지점없음' ELSE ( SELECT B.CENTER_NM FROM TB_CENTERINFO B WHERE B.CENTER_ID = A.CENTER_ID ) END AS CENTER_NM FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} ) X

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN LETTCCMMNDETAILCODE B ON A.BROD_INTERVAL = B.CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BRODBASICGROUP C ON A.BASIC_FILE_ID = C.BASIC_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CENTERINFO D ON A.CENTER_ID = D.CENTER_ID WHERE 1=1
AND A.BROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.CENTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.SEC_GUBUN = #{secGubun}
AND A.CENTER_ID IS NULL
AND A.CENTER_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT X.CENTER_ID AS centerId, X.CENTER_NM AS centerNm, X.BROD_CODE AS brodCode, XX.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, XX.ORIGNL_FILE_NM AS orignlFileNm, XX.PLAY_TIME AS playTime, XX.FILE_THUMNAIL AS fileThumnail, XX.INTERVAL_SECTION AS intervalSection, XX.BROD_SEQ AS brodSeq, XX.tbGubun, XX.ANNIVERSARY_TIME AS anniversaryTime, XX.ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME AS anniversaryStartTime, XX.CONTENT_STARTDAY AS contentStartDay, XX.CONTENT_ENDDAY AS contentEndDay FROM ( SELECT A.CENTER_ID, A.CENTER_NM, B.BROD_CODE FROM TB_CENTERINFO A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BRODSCHEDULE B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.CENTER_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.CENTER_GUBUN = 'BRANCH01' ) X LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT A.BROD_CODE, B.ATCH_FILE_ID, C.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, C.PLAY_TIME, C.FILE_THUMNAIL, B.INTERVAL_SECTION, B.CONTENT_STARTDAY, B.CONTENT_ENDDAY, B.BROD_SEQ, 'D' AS tbGubun, '' AS ANNIVERSARY_TIME, '' AS ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_BRODCONTENTDETAIL B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL C ON B.ATCH_FILE_ID = C.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.CENTER_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId} AND B.CONTENT_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD')
UNION ALL
SELECT A.BROD_CODE, B.ATCH_FILE_ID, C.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, C.PLAY_TIME, C.FILE_THUMNAIL, B.ANNIVER_STARTDAY, B.ANNIVER_ENDDAY, B.ANNIVERSARY_GUBUN AS INTERVAL_SECTION, B.BROD_ANNSEQ AS BROD_SEQ, 'A' AS tbGubun, B.ANNIVERSARY_TIME, B.ANNIVERSARY_STARTTIME FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE A JOIN TB_BRODANNIVERSARY B ON A.BROD_CODE = B.BROD_CODE JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL C ON B.ATCH_FILE_ID = C.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.CENTER_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId} AND B.ANNIVER_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') ) XX ON X.BROD_CODE = XX.BROD_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND X.CENTER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{centerNm}, '%')
ORDER BY X.CENTER_NM ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BRODSCHEDULE ( BROD_CODE, BROD_NAME, BROD_TOTALTIME, BROD_USEYN, BROD_INTERVAL, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BASIC_FILE_ID, SEC_GUBUN, BROD_STARTDAY, BROD_ENDDAY, CENTER_ID, BASIC_BROD_CODE ) VALUES ( #{brodCode}, #{brodName}, '0', #{brodUseYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brodInterval,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{basicFileId}, #{secGubun}, #{brodStartDay,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brodEndDay,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{centerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{basicBrodCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO TB_BRODSCHEDULE ( BROD_CODE, BROD_NAME, BROD_TOTALTIME, BROD_USEYN, BROD_INTERVAL, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BASIC_FILE_ID, SEC_GUBUN ) SELECT #{brodCode}, BROD_NAME, BROD_TOTALTIME, BROD_USEYN, BROD_INTERVAL, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BASIC_FILE_ID, SEC_GUBUN FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE = #{prebrodCode}

INSERT INTO TB_BRODSCHEDULE ( BROD_CODE, BROD_NAME, BROD_TOTALTIME, BROD_USEYN, BROD_INTERVAL, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BASIC_FILE_ID, SEC_GUBUN, CENTER_ID, BASIC_BROD_CODE ) SELECT #{brodCode}, #{brodName}, BROD_TOTALTIME, BROD_USEYN, BROD_INTERVAL, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BASIC_FILE_ID, SEC_GUBUN, #{centerId}, #{prebrodCode} FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE = #{prebrodCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BRODSCHEDULE SET BROD_NAME = #{brodName}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), BROD_USEYN = #{brodUseYn}, SEC_GUBUN = #{secGubun}, BROD_STARTDAY = #{brodStartDay,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BROD_ENDDAY = #{brodEndDay,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BASIC_FILE_ID = #{basicFileId}, BROD_INTERVAL = #{brodInterval}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}

UPDATE TB_BRODSCHEDULE SET BROD_NAME = #{brodName}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), BROD_USEYN = #{brodUseYn}, SEC_GUBUN = #{secGubun}, BASIC_FILE_ID = #{basicFileId}, BROD_INTERVAL = #{brodInterval}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CENTER_ID = #{centerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{basicBrodCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode}
UPDATE TB_BRODSCHEDULE SET CENTER_RELCNT = CENTER_RELCNT - 1 WHERE BROD_CODE = ( SELECT BASIC_BROD_CODE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE IN ( SELECT BROD_CODE FROM TB_BRODSCHEDULE WHERE BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} OR BASIC_BROD_CODE = #{brodCode} )
